deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for runtime-api in prod-usw

emily (ENG-RELEASES): watching perf dashboard — will keep an eye on p95 + 5xx

sanjay (oncall): ack. escalation criteria: 5xx > 0.8% sustained over 10m OR p95 > 150ms

ravi (infra): FYI autoscaler min=2 for canary, healthchecks=grpc/health, probe-interval=10s
ravi (infra): deploy command used:
```
./deploy --service runtime-api --env prod-usw --tag release/2026-03-18-rt --canary 5
```

deploy-bot: Canary wave complete (sample=1,200 requests) — metrics: 5xx=0.17% (baseline=0.12%), p95=72ms (baseline=68ms)

emily (ENG-RELEASES): slight uptick on 5xx, still below threshold. any error patterns in logs?

ravi (infra): correlates with jwt-ttl change in config. reverting jwt-ttl to 1800 for canary to test
ravi (infra): pinned runtime-api@v2.3.1 to tag `release/2026-03-18-rt` in canary manifest to avoid drift

deploy-bot: Config pinned for canary and smoke re-run initiated

deploy-bot: Smoke checks passed after pin + revert. No new auth errors in the last 8m

deploy-bot: Policy evaluation: metrics within tolerance, no SLO breach, can proceed to promotion

deploy-bot: Final rollout scheduled in 15m. Automated guardrails enabled (auto-rollback on breach)

deploy-bot: Final rollout complete, target=100% reached, all checks green
